necessary_condition.reason: The raw route cardinality before any model/filter is below N=250 in every burned OOF year at 1.25R and 1.50R. No classifier or threshold can repair this without violating the fixed frequency gate.
necessary_condition.implication: Do not spend another run tuning the 1.25R/1.50R delayed-commit hazard model.

win_rate_vs_runner_forensic.implication: The next policy must preserve a runner and cannot use blanket small-profit floors.

label_only_upper_bound.interpretation: The burned payoff distribution contains enough favorable outcomes in principle; the demonstrated bottleneck is causal winner identification / regime generalization / exit coupling, not absence of payoff support.

next_preregistered_reconstruction.name: EARLY_FIRST_PASSAGE_CAUSAL_COMMIT
semantics: No capital decision uses future MFE/MAE/final outcome.
First-passage bar is observation only; no same-bar capital.
Commit only on a later completed M1 hold/directional hold.
Use completed confirmation-bar micro-structure stop with no widening.
Canonical target remains unchanged and planned NetRR must be >=2.30.
Keep runner variants; any protective frontier must be next-bar armed and conservative on same-bar ambiguity.
Route/model/threshold selection is training-only for every OOF fold.
next_preregistered_reconstruction.reason: 0.25R/0.50R are the latest observed reaction states that retain a large raw supply buffer above N=250 in all burned years.
